name: @darkfactory/root
description: A modular, Postgres-first, AI-native application foundation.

scripts.operator:dev: bun run operator:bindings && bun scripts/dev.ts operator start
scripts.typecheck: bunx --no-install turbo run typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: bunx --bun --no-install biome lint . && bun run lint:markdown
scripts.auth:schema:check: corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/auth exec bun run auth:schema:check
scripts.api:openapi:generate: corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/api exec bun run openapi:generate
scripts.api:openapi:check: corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/api exec bun run openapi:check
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:contract && bun run test:operations && bun run test:integration && corepack pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.test:unit: bunx --no-install turbo run test:unit --concurrency=50% -- --maxWorkers=1 && bun run test:unit:root
scripts.test:unit:root: corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project unit tests/generator playwright.config.test.ts
scripts.test:contract: corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project contract
scripts.test:operations: corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project operations --project e2e-helpers --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:e2e-helpers: corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project e2e-helpers --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:integration: corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project integration
scripts.test:e2e: corepack pnpm exec playwright test --project e2e
scripts.test:coverage: corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project unit --project contract --project operations --coverage --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:a11y: corepack pnpm exec playwright test --project a11y
scripts.verify:static: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run auth:schema:check && bun run openapi:check && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run docs:check
scripts.verify:core: bun run verify:static && bun run test:unit && bun run test:contract && bun run test:operations
scripts.verify:core:ci: bun run verify:static && bun run test:e2e-helpers
scripts.verify:prepush: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run auth:schema:check && bun run openapi:check && bun run docs:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit && bun run test:contract && bun run test:operations
scripts.verify:browser: bun run build && corepack pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.verify: bun run verify:core:ci && bun run verify:coverage && bun run verify:integration && bun run verify:browser
scripts.deploy:web: bun run deploy:web:validate && corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/web exec bunx --no-install vinext-cloudflare deploy
scripts.deploy:web:check: bun run deploy:web:validate && corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/web exec bunx --no-install vinext-cloudflare deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy:web:preview: bun run deploy:web:validate && corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/web exec bunx --no-install vinext-cloudflare deploy --preview
scripts.deploy:web:staging: bun run deploy:web:validate && corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/web exec bunx --no-install vinext-cloudflare deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:web:staging:check: bun run deploy:web:validate && corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/web exec bunx --no-install vinext-cloudflare deploy --dry-run --env staging
scripts.db:generate: corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/db exec bun run db:generate
scripts.db:check: corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/db exec bun run db:check
scripts.db:migrate: corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/db exec bun run db:migrate
